name: space.net
summary: Perth ISP; acquired/merged into EFTel May 2000 (THE TRUSTEE FOR INTERNET TRUST (trust), ABN 13 150 289 399).

events.details: One of WA's earliest commercial ISPs; provable by 1997 (Cynosure Apr 1997 listing; space.net.au Wayback Dec 1997). Earlier 'by 1994' claim unsupportable — likely conflated with Munich's SpaceNet (founded Dec 1993).
